To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Borealin, a component of the CPC, binds nucleosomes and that this is required for chromosome association and function.

1) Borealin binds directly to nucleosomes, 2) this interaction is essential to secure the association of the CPC to chromosomes and 3) Borealin-mediated CPC chromosome association is critical for Haspind and Bub1 mediated centromere enrichment.
Borealin, through a multivalent nucleosome interaction, is essential to ensure chromosome association of the Chromosome Passenger Complex (CPR) and its function during mitosis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms that drive chromosome association of the Chromosome Passenger Complex (CPCP) during mitosis.
understanding the mechanisms driving chromosome association and function in the CPC.
the regulation of the chromosome association of a key regulator of cell division, the Chromosomal Passenger (CPC) complex, and the mechanisms that ensure its proper localization to chromosomes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Borealin is a master regulator of CPC localization to chromosomes and that Borealin mediated chromosome localization of CPC is essential for CPC function.
Borealin binds nucleosomes and is required for chromosome association of CPC and its function in chromosome segregation.
Borealin is a master regulator of the CPC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CPC binds to the chromosomes via Borealin and this binding is essential for its function.
Borealin is the glue that keeps CPC and chromosome together.
direct nucleosome binding of Borealin is essential for the chromosome association and functions of the CPC.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Borealin is the primary driver for chromosome association of the Chromosome Passenger Complex.
Borealin, a subunit of the CPC that has been considered to have no function in mitosis, is in fact a key regulator of the CPC.
Borealin is a master regulator of CPC chromosome association.
